title: Austin Names New City Manager
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened with the sole purpose of appointing Austin's new City Manager.
*   The council unanimously voted to offer the position of City Manager to James A. Wilson.
*   The meeting was brief, concluding within 45 minutes of its start.
